auth.register.title: Register a new account
auth.register.description:
Creates a new user account. The username is globally unique and the password is stored as a BCrypt hash. Returns the new user id.

[Errors] All failures are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with fields: code (the error code — clients should rely only on it), status (HTTP status), title (error kind), detail (localized message), errors (field-level validation errors, 400 only), details (extra scalars), traceId (correlation id), instance (request path).

This operation may return: AUTH_VALIDATION_001 (400, username must be 4-20 chars of letters/digits/underscore), AUTH_VALIDATION_002 (400, password must be 8-32 chars with letters and digits), AUTH_CONFLICT_001 (409, username already exists).
auth.captcha.title: Get a CAPTCHA image
auth.captcha.description: Generates a 4-character CAPTCHA (SVG returned as a data URI usable directly as <img src>) with its captchaId and expiry. Stored in Redis; expires after 2 minutes and is consumed on the first verification attempt regardless of outcome, preventing replay brute force. Required before logging in.
auth.login.title: Log in
auth.login.description:
Validates the CAPTCHA and credentials, then issues a session token (valid for 7 days; JWT + Redis dual-track session: JWT carries the signature, Redis tracks active sessions so logout/forced sign-out revokes immediately). The CAPTCHA is verified first and consumed on use (single attempt). Wrong username and wrong password return the same error code to prevent account enumeration.

[Errors] All failures are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with fields: code (the error code — clients should rely only on it), status (HTTP status), title (error kind), detail (localized message), errors (field-level validation errors, 400 only), details (extra scalars), traceId (correlation id), instance (request path).

This operation may return: AUTH_VALIDATION_003 (400, CAPTCHA wrong or expired — fetch a new one), AUTH_DENIED_001 (403, wrong username or password), KERNEL_VALIDATION_001 (400, request body is not a JSON object); missing required fields are rejected by request schema validation with 400.
auth.logout.title: Log out
auth.logout.description:
Revokes the session of the current token; the token becomes invalid immediately after the call (send {} as the body).

[Errors] All failures are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with fields: code (the error code — clients should rely only on it), status (HTTP status), title (error kind), detail (localized message), errors (field-level validation errors, 400 only), details (extra scalars), traceId (correlation id), instance (request path).

This operation may return: SECURITY_DENIED_001 (401, no token presented); calls with an already-revoked session are rejected during authentication.
auth.logout_all.title: Force sign-out (all devices)
auth.logout_all.description:
Revokes all sessions of the current account across devices (use after password change or suspected account compromise) and returns the number of revoked sessions; the caller's own token is revoked as well (send {} as the body).

[Errors] All failures are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with fields: code (the error code — clients should rely only on it), status (HTTP status), title (error kind), detail (localized message), errors (field-level validation errors, 400 only), details (extra scalars), traceId (correlation id), instance (request path).

This operation may return: SECURITY_DENIED_001 (401, no token presented).
auth.whoami.title: Who am I
auth.whoami.description:
Returns the caller's identity: whether authenticated, user id, authentication scheme and display name — useful to verify a token is actually valid. Requires a Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>).

[Errors] All failures are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with fields: code (the error code — clients should rely only on it), status (HTTP status), title (error kind), detail (localized message), errors (field-level validation errors, 400 only), details (extra scalars), traceId (correlation id), instance (request path).

This operation may return: SECURITY_DENIED_001 (401, no token presented), SECURITY_DENIED_003 (401, token invalid or session revoked/logged out).
openapi.tags.auth.name: Authentication
openapi.tags.auth.description: Register, log in, log out, force sign-out and identity query
auth.session_invalid: Session is invalid or has been revoked, please sign in again
auth.captcha_invalid: CAPTCHA is wrong or expired, please fetch a new one
openapi.schemas.problem_details.descript: Returned on failure as RFC 9457 ProblemDetails. Clients should rely only on code to identify the error type, never parse detail text.
openapi.schemas.problem_details.properti: Error code in <domain>_<kind>_<number> form, e.g. AUTH_CONFLICT_001. Clients use it to identify the error type
HTTP status code mapped from the error kind (VALIDATION 400 / CONFLICT 409 / DENIED 403 / NOTFOUND 404 / UNEXPECTED 500)
Error kind, i.e. the KIND segment of the code (VALIDATION / CONFLICT / DENIED etc.)
Human-readable message localized to the caller's language (Accept-Language negotiation)
Trace id of this invocation, for log correlation
Field-level validation errors, present only for VALIDATION. Keys are field paths (dot-separated, e.g. lines[0].sku), values are message arrays
Extra scalar details attached to the error (e.g. retryAfter, id); collections and objects are not emitted
